name: yt-downloader
description: Download YouTube videos to local storage

scripts.build: YOUTUBE_DL_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=true npm install && mkdir -p ./node_modules/youtube-dl-exec/bin && curl -L https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest/download/yt-dlp -o ./node_modules/youtube-dl-exec/bin/yt-dlp && chmod +x ./node_modules/youtube-dl-exec/bin/yt-dlp
